title: Xiaodu AI Watch Fit Launches: The Wenshin Large Model Fits into a Wrist-Worn Space for 159.8 Yuan

content_html:
A watch that can chat stands out particularly at the price range of 159.8 yuan. The Xiaodu AI Smart Watch Fit was officially released on July 27th, priced at 198 yuan, and with national subsidies it only costs 159.8 yuan, putting an AI terminal that can run Baidu's ERNIE large model directly into the hundred-yuan range.

Touching the screen and speaking out questions are the most straightforward capabilities of this watch. It will pass voice questions to the ERNIE large model for processing. Daily inquiries such as weather, clothing, and healthy diet can be instantly answered on the wrist, equivalent to attaching a ready-to-use question-and-answer interface on the skin. More amusingly, it supports generating personalized watch faces through voice - you just need to say something like an underwater world, cute pets, or traditional Chinese landscape, and the screen can turn imagination into visuals, letting the small space on the wrist grow personal aesthetics.

On a 1.95-inch ultra-clear full-screen, a 320×386 resolution IPS wide-angle panel is wrapped with curved glass, allowing you to browse by lifting your wrist. The entire device is only 8.8 mm thick and weighs 42 grams, with a metal textured frame and crown that keep the lines clean. Wearing it feels almost imperceptible, hiding "smartness" in its slimness rather than making it bulky on the wrist.

This watch breaks down sports into over 100 modes, including running, cycling, badminton, and yoga, like having an un-tiring coach around, accurately tracking calories and exercise duration. Behind the scenes, Baidu AI algorithms are quietly working, connecting heart rate, calories, steps, pace, and distance into a comprehensive picture of one's physical condition, allowing people to understand their bodies beyond vague feelings.

Health monitoring forms a comprehensive 24-hour network. A biometric tracking optical sensor continuously monitors emotions, stress, heart rate, and blood oxygen, and can automatically recognize sleep states, reconstructing the entire night's sleep structure. With a 300mAh battery and ultra-low power consumption chip, it can last up to five days under normal use and seven days in extreme cases, ensuring that this talking watch doesn't need to be charged immediately after being worn.

content_html_zh:
一款可以聊天的手表在159.8元的价格区间尤其引人注目。 小度AI智能手表Fit于7月27日正式发布，售价198元，国家补贴后仅需159.8元，让一款可以运行百度ERNIE大模型的AI终端直接进入百元区间。

触摸屏幕、说出问题是这款手表最直接的功能。 它将语音问题传递给ERNIE大模型进行处理。 天气、穿衣、健康饮食等日常询问都可以在手腕上即时得到解答，相当于在皮肤上贴上了一个随时可用的问答界面。 更有趣的是，它支持通过语音生成个性化表盘，你只需说出海底世界、可爱宠物、中国传统山水之类的内容，屏幕就能将想象转化为视觉效果，让手腕上的小空间生长出个人审美。

1.95英寸超清全面屏上，320×386分辨率的IPS广角面板被曲面玻璃包裹，抬腕即可浏览。 整机厚度仅为8.8毫米，重量为42克，金属质感的边框和表冠保持了线条的干净利落。 佩戴时感觉几乎难以察觉，纤薄中隐藏着“智能”，而不是让它戴在手腕上显得笨重。

这款手表将运动分为跑步、骑行、羽毛球、瑜伽等100多种模式，就像有一位不知疲倦的教练在身边，准确记录卡路里和运动时长。 在幕后，百度AI算法正在悄悄工作，将心率、卡路里、步数、配速、距离连接成一个人身体状况的全面图景，让人们超越模糊的感觉了解自己的身体。

健康监测形成24小时全方位网络。 生物追踪光学传感器持续监测情绪、压力、心率和血氧，并能自动识别睡眠状态，重建整个晚上的睡眠结构。 300mAh电池和超低功耗芯片，正常使用情况下最长可达5天，极端情况下可达7天，确保这款会说话的手表在佩戴后无需立即充电。
